title: The Burning Beekeeper
cn: 第 15 集 · 着火的养蜂人
novel: Lily and Marshall threw a [[housewarming|housewarming]] party at their new suburban home. They invited all their friends and neighbors. They wanted everything to be [[perfect|perfect]] for their first party in the new house. However, the evening quickly turned into a [[disaster|disaster]]. Ted nearly got into a [[fight|fight]] with Marshall's boss at the party. They had [[disagreed|disagree]] about architecture, and things got [[heated|heat]]. Ted felt [[insulted|insult]] by the boss's comments and almost threw a [[punch|punch]]. Marshall had to step in and separate them before things got worse. Meanwhile, Barney [[hit on|hit on]] a divorcée at the party. She was an [[attractive|attractive]] woman who had recently gone through a [[divorce|divorce]]. Barney used all his best lines, but she was not easily [[impressed|impress]]. She saw right through his [[charms|charm]] and [[rejected|reject]] his advances. Barney was not used to being turned down and felt [[confused|confuse]]. Robin tried to keep the party running [[smoothly|smooth]], but everything kept going wrong. The food was [[burning|burn]] in the oven, the drinks were running low, and a neighbor brought bees as a gift. The bees [[escaped|escape]] and caused [[chaos|chaos]] among the guests. Everyone ran around trying to avoid getting [[stung|sting]]. Marshall apologized to Lily for the [[disastrous|disastrous]] evening. She laughed and said it was the most [[memorable|memorable]] party she had ever had.

housewarming.en: a party for a new home

punch.en: a hit with a closed hand

divorce.en: the legal end of a marriage

confuse.en: to make unclear in the mind
